BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Santos, Harris, and Muri; by request of Superintendent of Public Instruction
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Changing the annual reporting date for the transitional bilingual instruction program.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the transitional bilingual instruction program reporting date; and amending RCW 28A.180.020.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 28A.180.020 and 1984 c 124 s 8 are each amended to read as follows:Annual report by superintendent of public instruction.
BillSection.P: The superintendent of public instruction shall review annually the transitional bilingual instruction program and shall submit a report of such review to the legislature on or before January 1 February 1st of each year.
